title: Miscellaneous
html:
Miscellaneous are various items which can be collected during the party's journey.

Overview

They may be valuables worth looting for sale to traders, important items which may move the story forward, books and notes which can be read, containers which store items or, in many cases, items used as set dressing which have little or no value at all.

The following comprise the different types of miscellaneous items which can be found throughout the game:

  • Story Items
  • Valuables
  • Books
  • Notes
  • Containers
  • Other

Story items

Main article: Story items

Story items are Miscellaneous items which are quest specific.

Normally these items further the plot of the story, allow to progress quests, or reveal important new information.

Valuables

Main article: Valuables

Valuables are Miscellaneous items with a weight to gold ratio that makes them particularly appealing for looting. They can be used for bartering, or selling to traders who are found in various locations throughout the game.

Valuable items generally appear in the form of precious gems, valuable metals, paintings, or high-quality kitchenware.

Books

Main article: Books

Books are Miscellaneous items in the form of properly bound books that can be read by the party.

Although Books sometimes contain information that aids in certain quests or helps to progress the story, most commonly they contain stories, lore, or background information on certain characters and / or locations.

Notes

Main article: Notes

Notes are Miscellaneous items in the form of loose paper or scrolls that can be read by the party.

Although Notes sometimes contain information that aids in certain quests or helps to progress the story, most commonly they contain stories, lore, or background information for certain characters and / or locations.

Containers

Main article: Containers

Containers are Miscellaneous items that can have other items removed from, or placed, within them.

Containers often serve as sources of loot scattered throughout the game and can typically be used to help organise the inventories of party members.

Other Miscellaneous

Other Miscellaneous items are those which do not fit in any of the above categories.

Interactive
